_doc: Endpoint config for scripts/fetch.mjs. Category names verified against the live wiki.gg category list (action=query&list=allcategories) on 2026-06-09 — see scripts/cache/map/README.md and the notes below.

_notes.categories: wiki.gg has NO flat 'Weapons'/'Shields'/'Armor' item lists — items live in leaf subcategories (e.g. Category:Daggers under Category:Melee Armaments under Category:Weapons), so those three are fetched recursively. Spirit ashes are Category:Ashes. Great runes are Category:Great Rune (singular). Multiplayer items are Category:Multiplayer items (lowercase i). Map fragments have no category — the 'Map <Region>' pages live inside Category:Key Items. Staffs/seals are Category:Glintstone Staves / Category:Sacred Seals (excluded from the Weapons recursion to keep them as their own files).
_notes.dlc: Most Shadow of the Erdtree items live in the SAME shared categories as base-game items (DLC weapon classes like Backhand Blades / Perfume Bottles are ordinary subcats of Melee Armaments). The only real DLC-specific categories found are listed at the end: 'Shadow of the Erdtree Talismans' (18), 'Ashes-Shadow of the Erdtree' (9, spirit ashes), 'Cookbooks: Shadow of the Erdtree' (55), 'Sorceries-Shadow of the Erdtree' (13), 'Key Items-Shadow of the Erdtree' (1). There are no DLC-specific categories for weapons/armor/incantations/ashes-of-war.
_notes.excludeSubcats: Recursion skips: Category:Ammunition + Category:Catalysts under Weapons (fetched separately as Arrows/Bolts/Glintstone Staves/Sacred Seals), Category:Armor Set under Armor (sets are index pages; the pieces are in Head/Chest/Arms/Legs), and anything matching /nightreign|^Images/i (different game / file categories).

map._doc: Fextralife interactive map. The map pages embed per-map iframes whose HTML contains the full marker dataset inline as `var items = [...]` (plus `var categories = [...]`). fetch.mjs downloads each iframe and extracts that JSON. Marker `id` IS the Fextralife `?id=` deep-link param (links like /Interactive+Map?id=4810&code=mapB appear on the page itself).
